correctness.rationale: Gaussian polar decomposition with independent radius correctly implements invariant normal and offset width weighting; normalizing denominator is E(range)=2*mu_m. Section vertices are exactly crossing simplex edges, so rank r gives Gaussian-order-statistic survival. Edge sums give independent mean. Gaussian quantile L1 convergence and max asymptotic prove sharp macroscopic tail; range concentration in L1 plus Gaussian binomial sandwich proves 2-U² exponent distribution. Boundary cases m=3,4 were verified numerically and by exact combinatorics; finite diagnostics not used to assert infinite results.
